verifications.claim: In 2026, Ramadan is expected to end on the evening of Thursday, March 19.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'ends after sundown Thursday, March 19'; R5: 'will end on March 19 or 20'; R3/R4 imply end of fasting on March 19 as Eid begins March 20.
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states the end date matching the claim exactly; other sources support or are consistent with March 19 as the end.

verifications.claim: In 2026, the celebration of Eid al-Fitr is expected to begin immediately after sunset or on Friday, March 20.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'expected to begin the evening of March 19'; R3: 'Eid al-Fitr has been confirmed for Friday, March 20'; R4: 'Eid al-Fitr 2026's date to be on Friday, March 20'; R5: 'expected to fall on the night of March 19 or March 20'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources collectively describe expectations for Eid starting evening of March 19 (after sunset) or on March 20, directly aligning with the claim's phrasing.

verifications.claim: The exact date of Ramadan's end depends on the sighting of the crescent moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'exact dates may depend on sightings of the crescent moon'; R3: 'depends on the crescent moon sighting'; R4: 'determined by the sighting of the crescent moon'; R5: 'depending on when spotters see the waxing crescent moon'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that the end date depends on moon sighting.
